 The nominations for 2026’s The Game Awards have been revealed and the yet-to-be-released “Grand Theft Auto IV” has landed eight nominations, including Game of the Year.
 Game Awards host and creator Geoff Keighley announced the nominees during a livestreamed special across YouTube and Twitch Tuesday.
 Along with Rockstar Games’ “ GTA 6 ,” the 2026 Game of the Year nominees include “007 First Light” (IO Interactive), “Control Resonant” (Remedy/Annapurna), “Phantom Blade Zero” (S-GAME), “Resident Evil Requiem” (Capcom) and “The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time” (Nintendo).

 Last year’s Game of the Year winner was the debut indie title “Clair Obscur Expedition 33.”
 The much-anticipated “Grand Theft Auto VI” will release Thursday, Nov. 19, just under the wire for the 2026 Game Awards’ eligibility window, which ends Friday (Nov. 20). Some fans speculated that because “GTA 6” has not yet been released, it would not be eligible for this year’s The Game Awards, or that if it was, the show had shifted its eligibility deadline to accommodate the unreleased title, a claim Keighley completely refutes.
 “People, I do think, plan around the show to some degree,” Keighley told Variety in an interview last week ahead of the nominations reveal. “I remember there was a thing a few weeks ago where everyone thought that we had changed our dates to accommodate ‘GTA,’ and it’s like no, actually our dates have been very set every year. It’s the same calendar that we have. And I don’t know this, but I’m sure some of these companies they consider that right when they’re looking at their release calendars and planning and whatnot. The reason we do the show in December is it is the biggest month of the year for gaming on a lot of fronts, and I think it’s a great way to sort of capstone the year, but also preview the year ahead.”
 The Game Awards nominations are chosen by a global jury of more than 100 media publications and creators, including Variety . Fans can visit TheGameAwards.com to explore the full list of nominees and cast their votes. The winners are selected by a combination of the jury’s and fans’ votes.
 The 2026 Game Awards will take place at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles Dec. 10. Led by Keighley, the show will follow its usual format of mixing the presentation of its video game industry awards with world premiere new game announcements and live musical performances.
 This year, The Game Awards will stream on more platforms than ever, including: Disney+, Roblox, Live TV on PS5, YouTube, Twitch, Steam, TikTok Live, X, Kick, Facebook and Instagram Live along with more than 20 platforms in China, including Baidu, Bilibili, Douyin, DouYu, Huya, WeChat, Weibo and Xiaohongshu. Other streaming partners include CHZZK and SOOP in South Korea, NicoNico in Japan, Vidio in Indonesia, Now TV in Hong Kong, mewatch in Singapore, and BIGO LIVE and Likee across Southeast Asia.
 Executive produced by Keighley and Kimmie Kim, The Game Awards are directed by Richard Preuss. LeRoy Bennett is the creative director, and Lara Karchmer is co-executive producer.
